ns2:course.label: Independent Study
ns2:course.description: Directed independent creative activity or research. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: Junior standing in Art and Design; and consent of instructor, advisor, and associate director of the School.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: Junior standing in Art and Design; and consent of instructor, advisor, and associate director of the School.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: For Art majors only. Class Materials Fee of up to $110 required. A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term.
